name: a4_screen_resume
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,dev; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; if [ -n "${G_URI:-}" ] && [ ! -f babylm/runs/a4_G/result.json ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_G; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$G_URI" babylm/runs/a4_G; fi; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.a4.data halves
